detail.longDescription: No matter how organized you think your Gmail inbox is, there's usually something you can streamline even better. That's what happened to me when I discovered how to automatically label emails in Gmail. I realize this feature has been around for a long time, but I'd never looked into it before. And ever since that first email popped into my inbox with a pre-attached label, I've been hooked. Here's everything you need to know about how to use Gmail labels.
